help_what: Them terminales NFC are dispositivos fisicos basados in ESP32 that itself instalan in comercios for accept payments with tarjetas NFC. Each user can tener a tarjeta NFC vinculada a its account that contiene its identificador unico.
help_purpose: Allow realizar transactions of it network of exchange of form presencial, without necesidad of a computador or telefono. The user acerca its tarjeta to the terminal, ingresa the monto and its PIN, and the payment itself procesa automaticamente.
help_keypad: Terminal with encoder rotativo and display. The comercio ingresa the monto with the encoder and the user confirma with its PIN.
help_touch: Terminal with pantalla tactil ILI9341. The comercio ingresa the monto tocando it pantalla.
help_web: The monto itself envia from it app web or movil. The terminal only confirma it tarjeta and the PIN.
help_community: Terminal of doble tarjeta: the user acerca its tarjeta and it of the comercio. No requires PIN, ideal for mercados comunitarios.
help_ble: Reader NFC that itself conecta via Bluetooth a a telefono or computador. Util when there is no WiFi available.
help_tab_terminals: List of them terminales ESP32 registrados in the node. Shows if estan activos and when itself vieron by ultima time.
help_tab_provision: Proceso of configure a terminal ESP32 new. Necesitas conectarlo by USB, read its chip ID, and download the firmware compilado.
help_tab_cards: Emitir tarjetas NFC for users and change PINs. It tarjeta only contiene the ID of the user, no it key private. If itself pierde, is deactivated and itself emite other.
help_tab_tx: History of payments realizados a traves of them terminales NFC.

help_pairing: The administrator emite a tarjeta NFC asignandola a a user (User ID) and registrando the UID of it tarjeta fisica. It tarjeta itself entrega to the user with a PIN inicial that must change it first time that it use.
help_pin: Is a codigo of 4 digitos that protege it tarjeta NFC. Itself pide to the user in each transaccion (except in modo comunitario). If itself olvida, the administrator can resetearlo a a value by defecto.

card_classic_desc: Tarjeta economica with 15 sectores. Each sector has Key A (lectura) and Key B (escritura) independientes. Itself graba a certificate of 16 bytes replicado 3 times in them 3 bloques of each sector. Only 1 sector is the active in each momento. Despues of each payment, the certificate rota a other sector aleatorio. Requires document of identidad to the pay.
card_ntag_desc: Tarjeta with cifrado AES-128. In each tap genera automaticamente a codigo criptografico (MAC) that the server verifica. Anti-clonacion: nobody can copy it tarjeta without it key AES. Mas economica that DESFire EV3.
card_desfire_desc: Tarjeta of alta seguridad with challenge-response AES-128 complete. The server envia a desafio, it tarjeta responde with cifrado AES. It opcion mas segura. EV3 = tercera generacion of the estandar DESFire.

desc_keypad: Terminal ESP32 with encoder rotativo and pantalla pequena. The user gira the encoder for select the monto and confirma with a clic. Ideal for mercados and ferias where itself needs a hardware dedicado and resistente.
desc_web: Point of sale in the browser. Ideal for iPhone, computers or any device without an Android app. Can use Bluetooth NFC reader. The client pays by scanning a QR or with NFC card. NOTE: No browser data is needed to register. The terminal is assigned to a user/organization, and the owner approves each browser session from their account (My Points of Sale > POS Web Sessions).
desc_touch: Terminal ESP32 with pantalla tactil complete. The vendedor toca them buttons in pantalla for entrar the monto. Mas intuitivo that the encoder, ideal for users that no estan familiarizados with hardware dedicado.
desc_community: Dual-card ESP32 terminal for community markets. Reads both the seller's card and the buyer's card in a single transaction. Designed for community barter where both members must be present.
desc_android_pos: Aplicacion Android (telefono or tablet) that works as punto of venta. Itself empareja with the node via codigo corto of 6 digitos. No requires hardware dedicado — usa the telefono of the vendedor. Genera cobros by QR and NFC. Ideal for vendedores that already have a telefono Android.
desc_ble_reader: Reader NFC Bluetooth (accesorio). No is a terminal — itself asocia to the POS web or Android from it app of the POS. No itself registra aqui.
desc_default: Tipo of hardware of the terminal.
